features.name: Control Undead / Dreadful Aspect
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you take control of Undead or emit a wave of fear.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.desc: You, Undead, and Fiends within 10 feet add your Cha modifier to melee weapon damage.

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.desc: Resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.desc: As an action, you shroud yourself in darkness for 1 minute: a 30-foot aura of fear, your shadow allies make extra attacks, and attacks against you have Disadvantage.
